definitions.explanation: A samurai without a lord or master during the feudal period. Ronin lost their position through the death or fall of their master, or through dismissal.

definitions.gloss: exam retaker, student studying for another year to retake entrance exams
definitions.explanation: A student who failed university entrance exams and is spending a year (or more) preparing to retake them. This is the most common modern usage.

examples.japanese: {赤穂|あこう}{浪士|ろうし}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{浪人|ろうにん}だ。
examples.english: The Ako ronin are famous masterless samurai.

examples.japanese: {江戸時代|えどじだい}には{多|おお}くの{浪人|ろうにん}が{城下町|じょうかまち}をさまよっていた。
examples.english: During the Edo period, many ronin wandered through castle towns.

examples.japanese: {志望校|しぼうこう}に{落|お}ちて{浪人|ろうにん}した。
examples.english: I failed the exam for my school of choice and became a ronin.

examples.japanese: {一年間|いちねんかん}{浪人|ろうにん}して、{第一志望|だいいちしぼう}の{大学|だいがく}に{合格|ごうかく}した。
examples.english: After studying for a year as a ronin, I passed the exam for my first-choice university.

examples.japanese: {浪人|ろうにん}{生活|せいかつ}は{精神的|せいしんてき}につらかったが、{結果的|けっかてき}には{良|よ}い{経験|けいけん}になった。
examples.english: Life as a ronin was mentally tough, but it turned out to be a good experience.

examples.japanese: {浪人|ろうにん}{中|ちゅう}は{予備校|よびこう}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: During my ronin year, I attend a prep school.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
In modern Japan, {浪人|ろうにん} most commonly refers to students who did not gain admission to their desired university and are spending an extra year (or more) studying to retake entrance exams. These students often attend {予備校|よびこう} (cram schools). The term carries no strong stigma, as retaking exams is relatively common. Students who take one extra year are called {一浪|いちろう}, two years {二浪|にろう}, and so on.

The historical meaning of a masterless samurai is well known through stories like the {忠臣蔵|ちゅうしんぐら} (tale of the 47 ronin).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {浪人|ろうにん}する: to become a ronin (spend a gap year)
- {浪人|ろうにん}{生|せい}: a ronin student
- {浪人|ろうにん}{生活|せいかつ}: life as a ronin student
- {一浪|いちろう}: one year as a ronin
- {浪人|ろうにん}{中|ちゅう}: during one's ronin period
